name: operational-interface-doctrine
_note: Machine-readable source of truth for the doctrine's public contract (§14). Hand-edited. scripts/build-system.js generates dist/system/* from this file; scripts/validate-contract.js enforces the schema and cross-references. Changing a stable axis value is a MAJOR version bump (§19) because domain adapters may switch exhaustively.

naming._note: Public naming contract (§6). The namespace is intentionally 'oi', never 'dr' — the doctrine is theme-neutral and Dark Roast is only its first reference mapping.

axes._note: Orthogonal state axes (§7). The generic `data-state` attribute is prohibited (§5.3): loading is not severity, staleness is not warning, selection is not emphasis, certainty is not freshness, partial data is not a loading state. Interaction is deliberately absent — native pseudo-classes, native attributes, and ARIA own it (§7.10).

axisStability._note: Stable axes carry semantic-version protection. Adding a value to a stable closed axis is MAJOR (§19).

truthAxes._note: The subset that carries provenance semantics (§9). A truth-bearing primitive MUST provide a non-color channel for every truth property it renders; tooltips alone are insufficient for critical truth state.

semanticRoles._note: Required semantic contract categories (§8). Primitives and recipes consume ONLY these. Direct use of a palette primitive such as --dr-espresso above the mapping layer is the 'token soup' anti-pattern (§23) and fails validation.

primitives._note: The ten initial structural primitives (§10). A primitive qualifies only when it owns a stable responsibility — repeated CSS is not sufficient justification (§5.14). `axes` lists the contract axes the primitive consumes.

stack.responsibility: Vertical rhythm; parent owns gap and alignment

cluster.responsibility: Inline grouping with gap, alignment, and wrap policy

rail.responsibility: Fixed and fluid column relationship with an explicit collapse rule

inset.responsibility: Recessed focus, evidence, or visualization region with an overflow policy

divider.responsibility: Structural separation, declared semantic or decorative

metric.responsibility: Label, value, unit, trend, and provenance alignment with tabular numerics

meter.responsibility: Normalized quantitative progress with accessible min, max, current, and label

disclosure.responsibility: Expandable content structure owning aria-expanded and focus behavior

history-strip.responsibility: Compact temporal distribution with a non-color intensity channel

recipes._note: Recipes are the primary unit of reusable design intelligence (§5.15). They define region order, slot anatomy, relationships, density, responsive transformation, surface nesting, optionality, overflow, and disclosure — never business logic, product actions, data fetching, domain language, or palette selection.

compact-monitor._studyNote: Recorded inline as doctrine §21 (Clauddy). §15 reserves src/system/studies/claude-usage-monitor.md for the extracted standalone study; that file is not yet written, so the reference points at the section that exists rather than a placeholder.

reservedRecipeNames._note: Reserved to prevent competing implementations, but not public contracts until separately designed and proven (§11.2). `conversation-shell` and `context-composer` are candidates arising from src/system/studies/phind-extension.md.

stabilityLadder._note: External designs enter through documented studies, never direct transplantation (§18). No stable primitive or recipe exists without a real consumer.

forbiddenDomainTerms._note: Domain vocabulary that must not appear in contracts, primitives, or recipes (§5.13, §17.1). Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries by the source scan. Deliberately conservative: generic words such as 'note', 'chart', and 'transfer' are excluded because substring collisions would produce false failures.

generatedTypes._note: TypeScript type names emitted by scripts/build-system.js for each axis, plus the structural enumerations.
